title: Constructible preservation for the original completed coefficient datum
statement: Let (A,I) be the adic coefficient datum of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], in the original coefficient universe, and use the three-clause full category of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete]. Let square be a [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square] on noetherian finite-dimensional schemes X, Y, X-prime, Y-prime, with both vertical arrows proper. Suppose a positive integer N annihilates A/I and is invertible on all four schemes, and every geometric fibre of f has dimension at most e. For each K in that category on X, its ordinary completed-coefficient direct image Rf_*K, completed pullback Lg*comp Rf_*K, completed pullback Lg-prime*comp K, and ordinary direct image Rf-prime* Lg-prime*comp K belong to the same category on Y, Y-prime, X-prime, Y-prime respectively. Completed pullbacks and ordinary direct images are the specified functors of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback] and [prop-weil-pbc-direct-image-limits]; no lift or replacement of A is used.

proof.text: Prove intrinsic completeness is invariant under isomorphism by using the same generator tuple and cochain representative. The completion reflector unit is invertible on complete objects. The unit-compatible direct-image/completion isomorphism makes its unit invertible on every direct image. The actual/strict completed-pullback comparison identifies the pullback of a complete object with the actual completed pullback, which is intrinsically complete. Apply these arguments successively to all four outputs.

proof.text: Apply normalized constructible local effectivity to the canonical reduction tower, using constructibility and its common interval. Each level then has a bounded constructible etale origin. Choose its pro-etale complex using exact realization, and compare its realization with the canonical function presentation using the associated-restriction universal property and scalar identity. Exact faithful functors reflect the lower bound. Construct adjacent normalizations by full faithful realization; bounded-below site comparison lifts each normalization and inverse. Injectivity on morphisms proves the inverse identities and the comparison equation. Functor.map_preimage proves compatibility with the canonical reduction normalization.

proof.text: Use the canonical reduction adic tower. Normalized constructible local effectivity supplies uniform local models from the common interval and constructible cohomology. Its underlying semilinear transition is exactly the canonical reduction transition by the scalar-extension adjunction apply_symm_apply identity. Together with the proved intrinsic completeness and compatible origins these are the three membership clauses for each output.

lean.statement:
theorem AdicCoefficientDatum.constructible_preservation
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    {X' X Y' Y : Scheme.{u}}
    {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y}
    (sq : ChosenCartesianSquare g' f' f g)
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian X'] [IsNoetherian Y']
    (hDimX : ∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim X ≤ (n : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hDimY : ∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim Y ≤ (n : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hDimX' : ∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim X' ≤ (n : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hDimY' : ∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim Y' ≤ (n : WithBot ℕ∞))
    [IsProper f] [IsProper f']
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hAnn : (N : A ⧸ d.ideal) = 0)
    (hNX : IsUnit (N : Γ(X, ⊤))) (hNY : IsUnit (N : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    (hNX' : IsUnit (N : Γ(X', ⊤))) (hNY' : IsUnit (N : Γ(Y', ⊤)))
    (e : ℕ)
    (hFibres : ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
      (y : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y),
      topologicalKrullDim (pullback f y : Scheme.{u}) ≤ (e : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (K : d.derived X) (hK : PbcIsBoundedConstructibleComplete X d K) :
    PbcIsBoundedConstructibleComplete Y d ((d.push f).obj K) ∧
      PbcIsBoundedConstructibleComplete Y' d
        ((d.completedPull g).obj ((d.push f).obj K)) ∧
      PbcIsBoundedConstructibleComplete X' d ((d.completedPull g').obj K) ∧
      PbcIsBoundedConstructibleComplete Y' d
        ((d.push f').obj ((d.completedPull g').obj K))
lean.note: The full membership assembly is proved. Only finite-reduction control remains as a separate named source lemma. The original adic datum is preserved without universe-changing coefficient identifications.
